cuts.label: joebartolozzi@momenttireddependablegoblinmrdestructoid-3x7wqdn4vov78eq9/joebartolozzi-bart-bartolozzi-2026w41
cuts.title: Joe said GTA can't get him in trouble, then this mission started
cuts.hook: Joe said GTA is fine for Twitch
cuts.retelling: Joe claims nothing in GTA could get him banned on Twitch, then the next mission has him photographing a celebrity having sex, and he tells his editor to blur the whole thing.

cuts.label: jynxzi@momentgrosssmellybubbleteamvgame-a-ahkjjslbajojhs/jynxzi-about-cave-2026w41
cuts.title: Jynxzi promised a 200 IQ play and Los died to a creeper
cuts.retelling: Jynxzi brags he's about to pull a 200 IQ play in Minecraft and has Los follow him, but while Jynxzi is busy dropping on a mob, a creeper falls on Los, and Los has to admit it was his own fault for not paying attention.

cuts.label: xqc@vod2872612045/xqc-about-advance-2026w37
cuts.title: xQc's GTA crew rapped about burgers, then got an offer sheet
cuts.retelling: xQc's roleplay group freestyles a burger rap, and a cap-wearing man tells them they passed and promises a $100,000 advance and radio play.

cuts.label: forsen@vod2872145958/forsen-based-forsen-2026w37
cuts.title: Forsen leads the push, then revives the enemy
cuts.hook: Forsen leads the squad. It goes badly
cuts.retelling: Forsen confidently orders his squad to push the circle, gets shot at, then later revives an enemy by mistake and dies, so he is shown to be a bad leader.

cuts.label: scout:kaicenat+xevi+zylok/kaicenat-xevi-zylok-accus-cenat-2026w41
cuts.title: Reggie said Kai left him on scene. Kai shows the call.
cuts.retelling: Reggie accused Kai Cenat of abandoning him during a crisis, Kai showed a call log saying he called back at the same minute, and Kai later said Reggie's promised proof never came.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2888642092/kaicenat-cenat-proof-2026w41
cuts.title: Kai Cenat loses it: "Where is your proof?"
cuts.hook: Kai wants an update on Reggie
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat can't get any word from someone called Reggie, and a few minutes later he storms off saying he's done because the evidence someone promised never showed up.

cuts.label: stableronaldo@vod2877716208/stableronaldo-about-hole-2026w38
cuts.title: Stableronaldo's build crew can't get out of their own walls
cuts.retelling: Stableronaldo and his friends get trapped inside the walls they were building, bicker over whose idea it was, and shout for help, and later in the stream they are still stuck.

cuts.label: scout:hasanabiproductions+unemployednewsnetwork+xqc+xqcclips/hasanabiproductions-unemployednewsnetwork-xqc-xqcclips-about-call-2026w40
cuts.title: xQc rips into Hasan. Then Hasan answers
cuts.retelling: xQc says Hasan watches his words because his paying viewers are brain-dead, and Hasan replies that xQc can hate him all day as long as he moves in a more woke direction, but the reply cuts off mid-sentence.

cuts.label: squeex@momentsneakyminiaturesowbabyrage-5c9hnmwgidmbkmef/squeex-about-charact-2026w38
cuts.title: How Chatterbox ended up on the break room floor
cuts.hook: Chatterbox takes on the whole break room
cuts.retelling: In a roleplay city, Chatterbox is blamed by others for a shooting he says they ordered, and the scene ends with someone being carted off by EMS while Squeex says goodbye.
